# Weavy

> Weavy is an AI-powered node-based design platform that integrates multiple generative AI models (GPT, Runway, Stable Diffusion, Flux, and others) to streamline creative workflows for professional designers and artists.

Weavy serves creative professionals and enterprises with an intuitive design interface that combines image generation, video generation, and design automation. The platform emphasizes artistic intelligence—leveraging AI to enhance rather than replace human creativity—and offers community programs for AI creators.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered design platform
- Node-based editor
- Image generation
- Video generation
- Multi-model integration
- Generative AI
- Creative workflow automation
- Enterprise solution
- Flux Pro
- Runway Gen-4
- Stable Diffusion 3.5
- Design automation
- AI creators
- Professional editing tools
- Creative professionals

## Product Overview

- [Weavy | AI-Powered Design Workflows, Built for Creative Pros](https://www.weavy.ai): Main platform homepage showcasing Weavy's node-based design interface integrating GPT, Runway, and Stable Diffusion 3.5 for AI-powered creative workflows
- [About Weavy - Bridging AI and the Creative Mindset | Weavy.ai](https://www.weavy.ai/about-us): Company mission and vision: Artistic Intelligence enhancing human creativity through advanced AI technology integration

## Plans & Pricing

- [Weavy Pricing – Flexible Plans for Creative Pros & Teams](https://www.weavy.ai/pricing): Subscription tiers and credit system for Weavy including access to Flux models and various plan levels for individual and team use

## Enterprise & Teams

- [Weavy for Enterprise - AI-First Design at Scale | Weavy.ai](https://www.weavy.ai/enterprise): Enterprise-grade solution for design teams with production-ready AI workflows, brand control, and team collaboration features

## Community & Creator Programs

- [Weavy Artist Collective – A Home for Leading AI Creators](https://www.weavy.ai/collective): Membership program for AI creators offering early access to features, community networking, and support for leading creative professionals
- [Affiliate](https://www.weavy.ai/affiliate): Affiliate program for creators, educators, and community leaders with recurring commission opportunities
